### More Than a Printer


You deserve a partner who makes it easy to meet your goals. Good news—you just found one. At Meyers,
we’re dedicated to creating a sustainable future for people, products, and our planet. We believe
that great packaging is a powerful, yet humble tool that enhances our daily lives, introduces us to
our favorite new foods, and inspires unforgettable adventures.

We make that happen by creating sustainable packaging, and labels. And it takes a special group to
deliver such a tall order. Our team is a collection of hard-working, caring problem solvers who
enable innovative brand leaders. Join us, great things lie ahead!

### Our Solutions

From high-impact folding cartons to cutting-edge RFID, our solutions are
engineered for results.

[[Folding Cartons]][20]

##### [Folding Cartons][21]

Premium folding cartons and carton packaging built for retail success. Custom, sustainable
paperboard boxes to help brands deliver standout results.

[[Folding Cartons]][22]

##### [RFID Solutions][23]

More than a plain RFID label. We embed custom RFID into packaging, labels, and backer cards, even
complex, out-of-the-ordinary solutions.

[[Folding Cartons]][24]

##### [Pressure Sensitive Labels][25]

Custom pressure sensitive labels backed by expert guidance. Our label specialists help brands solve
even the most challenging packaging needs.

[[Folding Cartons]][26]

##### [Packaging][27]

Packaging solutions from folding cartons to labels. Help your brand stand out with high-impact,
sustainable, retail-ready packaging options.

[[Folding Cartons]][28]

##### [Instant Redeemable Coupons (IRCs)][29]

IRCs and on-pack coupons that increase sales at retail. Proven strategies for effective promotions
that drive shopper engagement and loyalty.

[[Folding Cartons]][30]

##### [Conductive Ink Printer][31]

Conductive ink printing for high-volume production. Roll-to-roll expertise and engineering support
trusted by aerospace, medical, and electronics brands.

[Packaging][32]

[Product Labels][33]

### **Like Goldilocks, Just the Right Size**

We’re a third generation family business that’s large enough to deliver and small enough to care. We
print tens of millions of pieces per year for Microsoft and just a few thousand for growing brands.
No matter your size, our partnership will mean a lot to Meyers, and you’ll feel that every day.

[LEARN MORE][34]

### ****Gurus of Products & Planet****

How do the best brands become sustainability leaders? It starts with packaging and extends into your
supply chain, your impact data, and beyond. You need a partner with a wealth of experience and
knowledge about sustainable packaging and manufacturing. Forget the companies just joining the
sustainability party now, you’ve found your guru.

[LEARN MORE][35]

### ****Awesome Meets Easy****

Very few shoppers understand how much effort goes into creating the product packaging and labels
found on store shelves.

[[Pressure-sensitive label applications]][44]

## [The Best Pressure Sensitive Label Materials for Food and Beauty Packaging][45]

July 15, 2026
Not all pressure sensitive label materials are designed for the same environment. Food packaging
often requires moisture resistance, cold-temperature performance, and cost efficiency, while beauty
packaging demands durability, premium aesthetics, and resistance to oils and chemicals. This guide
compares the most common label materials used in food and beauty packaging, helping brands choose
the right solution based on product requirements, sustainability goals, and shelf impact.
[LEARN MORE >> The Best Pressure Sensitive Label Materials for Food and Beauty Packaging][46]
[[folding carton supplier]][47]

## [How to Choose the Right Paperboard Grade for Folding Cartons][48]

July 1, 2026
Selecting the right paperboard is one of the most important decisions in folding carton packaging.
The material you choose affects everything from shelf appeal and print quality to sustainability
performance and packaging costs. In this guide, you'll learn how SBS, CRB, URB, and FSC® and
SFI®-certified paperboard options compare, helping you choose the best folding carton material for
your product, brand goals, and supply chain requirements.
[LEARN MORE >> How to Choose the Right Paperboard Grade for Folding Cartons][49]

## [Pressure Sensitive Labels for Complex CPG SKUs][50]

June 24, 2026
Pressure-sensitive labels help CPG brands simplify packaging updates, launch new SKUs faster, and
manage multiple product versions with less inventory. For operations teams, that means fewer
disruptions. For brand teams, it means stronger shelf presence. For procurement teams, it means a
scalable packaging program that supports growth.
[LEARN MORE >> Pressure Sensitive Labels for Complex CPG SKUs][51]

## Certifications & Accreditations

[ecovadis-certification]

The EcoVadis Bronze certification is a rating awarded to companies that rank within the top 35% of
all companies for their overall sustainability performance. It indicates a strong awareness of
social and environmental impacts, a commitment to continuous improvement, and a structured approach
to sustainability management across environmental, labor, ethics, and sustainable procurement
criteria. 

A Sustainable Green Printing Partnership (SGP) certification is a comprehensive, third-party
validation for print and packaging facilities that meet high environmental standards and demonstrate
best practices for sustainability across their entire operations. This certification involves a
comprehensive audit to ensure a facility reduces waste and energy consumption, transitions to
sustainable materials, creates safer workplaces, and maintains a strong sustainability management
system.

The Great Printer Environmental Initiative Program recognizes printers who exceed required mandates
in compliance with all Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) rules, regulations, and laws. Great
Printers demonstrate their commitment to minimizing their impact on human health and the environment
while producing quality printed products.

# Custom Label Manufacturing
# QR Codes • Variable Data • Sticker Sheets

Welcome to Midwest Label Supply! We are a custom digital printer and convertor of labels with
software automation in our DNA. Our sweet spot is custom [variable data printing][34] of
individualized [serialized QR code labels][35], [Data Matrix codes][36], 2D barcodes and other smart
labels. Whether you need serialized QR labels for product authentication or an [API-connected direct
mail printer][37] that triggers from your CRM, we handle it. Midwest Label Supply prints
high-quality, custom, [pressure-sensitive labels][38] for a variety of technical applications.

## Serialized QR Code Labels & Variable Data Printing

Our specialty in [serialized QR code labels][39] and [variable data printing][40] enables unique
serialization for product tracking and customer engagement. Each serialized QR label gets its own
unique code, so you can track individual items from production line to end consumer. Our [variable
data label printer technology][41] provides cutting-edge solutions for modern businesses. Recent
enhancements in [QR Code Labels][42], [Data Matrix Labels][43], NFC Chips and RFID tags provide
opportunities for advances in tracking, individualization and serialization of products and
processes. We work with CPG companies to manufacture beautiful labels while eliminating supply chain
difficulties through product lifecycle tracking. Our digital printing process enables small runs
with variable content information (text, images, codes, UIDs) for enhanced customer experiences.

## Custom Sticker Sheets & On-Demand Fulfillment

Our [on-demand digital printing][44], die cutting and custom sticker sheet production, paired with
packaging services allows us to provide direct fulfillment to customers across the US. From single
custom sticker sheets to large format [variable data label sheets][45], we handle everything from
design to delivery. Need to trigger print jobs programmatically? Our direct mail API printer
capabilities let you send orders straight from your ecommerce platform or CRM. We also help [foreign
companies save money on direct mail][46] by sending from within the US to avoid international post
restrictions and tariffs.

## Popular Label Solutions

#### [Short Run Labels][47]

NO minimum orders! Perfect for startups and small batches with fast turnaround.

#### [Pressure Sensitive Labels][48]

Self-adhesive labels in 50+ materials for automated and hand application.

#### [Custom Die Cutting][49]

Precision cutting for unique shapes and specialized applications.

#### [Milwaukee Label Printing][50]

Local Milwaukee service with same-day pickup available.

#### [Chicago Label Printing][51]

Next-day delivery to Chicagoland area businesses.

#### [Direct Mail API][52]

REST API, signed webhooks, and USPS Informed Visibility tracking. A Lob, PostGrid, and Postalytics
alternative.

# Custom Label Manufacturing
# QR Codes • Variable Data • Sticker Sheets

Welcome to Midwest Label Supply! We are a custom digital printer and convertor of labels with
software automation in our DNA. Our sweet spot is custom [variable data printing][34] of
individualized [serialized QR code labels][35], [Data Matrix codes][36], 2D barcodes and other smart
labels. Whether you need serialized QR labels for product authentication or an [API-connected direct
mail printer][37] that triggers from your CRM, we handle it. Midwest Label Supply prints
high-quality, custom, [pressure-sensitive labels][38] for a variety of technical applications.

## Serialized QR Code Labels & Variable Data Printing

Our specialty in [serialized QR code labels][39] and [variable data printing][40] enables unique
serialization for product tracking and customer engagement. Each serialized QR label gets its own
unique code, so you can track individual items from production line to end consumer. Our [variable
data label printer technology][41] provides cutting-edge solutions for modern businesses. Recent
enhancements in [QR Code Labels][42], [Data Matrix Labels][43], NFC Chips and RFID tags provide
opportunities for advances in tracking, individualization and serialization of products and
processes. We work with CPG companies to manufacture beautiful labels while eliminating supply chain
difficulties through product lifecycle tracking. Our digital printing process enables small runs
with variable content information (text, images, codes, UIDs) for enhanced customer experiences.

## Custom Sticker Sheets & On-Demand Fulfillment

Our [on-demand digital printing][44], die cutting and custom sticker sheet production, paired with
packaging services allows us to provide direct fulfillment to customers across the US. From single
custom sticker sheets to large format [variable data label sheets][45], we handle everything from
design to delivery. Need to trigger print jobs programmatically? Our direct mail API printer
capabilities let you send orders straight from your ecommerce platform or CRM. We also help [foreign
companies save money on direct mail][46] by sending from within the US to avoid international post
restrictions and tariffs.

## Popular Label Solutions

#### [Short Run Labels][47]

NO minimum orders! Perfect for startups and small batches with fast turnaround.

#### [Pressure Sensitive Labels][48]

Self-adhesive labels in 50+ materials for automated and hand application.

#### [Custom Die Cutting][49]

Precision cutting for unique shapes and specialized applications.

#### [Milwaukee Label Printing][50]

Local Milwaukee service with same-day pickup available.

#### [Chicago Label Printing][51]

Next-day delivery to Chicagoland area businesses.

#### [Direct Mail API][52]

REST API, signed webhooks, and USPS Informed Visibility tracking. A Lob, PostGrid, and Postalytics
alternative.

[custom label samples]

Let our experienced label team here at MPI Labels work with you to create a custom label solution

## Label Production

with over 58 years of experience in the label industry to help you navigate through the process with

for quicker and easier sharing of all necessary files.

### In House Prepress

to help you create the best labels for your business (and with the ability to prepare and output
plates in house).

### [Equipment Service and Repair][50]

to ensure your labeling equipment can meet your deadlines.

## **Custom Printed** Label Types

### [Digital and
### Flexographic Labels][51]

Whether your project lends itself more so to digital labels or flexographic labels (based off
factors such as run size), both of these two pressure sensitive label solutions create a very
similar “sticker-like” result which can be attached to most shapes and surfaces with ease.

### [Roll Fed
### Wrap Labels][52]

Custom roll fed wrap labels are just as they sound- a label solution that wraps completely around a
product to offer 360-degree coverage. Due to the nature of these labels, they are found almost
exclusively on mostly-cylindrical containers such as bottles, cans, and tubes.

### [Shrink Sleeve
### Labels][53]

Regardless of your intended application of shrink (whether it be full shrink sleeve packaging,
multi-pack shrink bands, or preform neck shrink bands), all shrink products feature a 360-degree
label sleeve (or band) which is heated and shrunk to conform to the unique shape of your container.

### [Smart Labeling
### and Tags][54]

Smart Labels—Radio Frequency Identification (abbr. RFID) and Near Field Communication (abbr.
NFC)—are the future of asset tracking, inventory management, and even interactive marketing. In very
simplified terms, think of RFID and NFC as the new and improved alternatives to barcoding AND QR
codes.

## [**Label Equipment**
## and Supplies][55]

MPI Labels is an industry leader when it comes to all things “labels” so it should come as no
surprise that we have an entire department dedicated to helping your business determine the right
labeling equipment for your needs. Whether you’re utilizing us for your label production or not, we
are here to help you determine what labeling systems and equipment your business should be
implementing.  Our labeling systems and equipment include label applicators, print and apply
systems, RFID labeling equipment, heat shrink sleeve applicators, heat tunnels, steam tunnels, steam
generators, and standard and custom made systems, stands, and accessories.

We can source the largest collection of equipment replacement parts and printer consumables- such as
ink, drums, ribbon, software, and more. Whatever labeling device, MPI Labels can supply you all the
supplies, parts, and support to continue printing uninterrupted.

to ensure your labeling equipment can meet your deadlines.

## **Custom Printed** Label Types

### [Digital and
### Flexographic Labels][51]

Whether your project lends itself more so to digital labels or flexographic labels (based off
factors such as run size), both of these two pressure sensitive label solutions create a very
similar “sticker-like” result which can be attached to most shapes and surfaces with ease.

### [Roll Fed
### Wrap Labels][52]

Custom roll fed wrap labels are just as they sound- a label solution that wraps completely around a
product to offer 360-degree coverage. Due to the nature of these labels, they are found almost
exclusively on mostly-cylindrical containers such as bottles, cans, and tubes.

### [Shrink Sleeve
### Labels][53]

Regardless of your intended application of shrink (whether it be full shrink sleeve packaging,
multi-pack shrink bands, or preform neck shrink bands), all shrink products feature a 360-degree
label sleeve (or band) which is heated and shrunk to conform to the unique shape of your container.

### [Smart Labeling
### and Tags][54]

Smart Labels—Radio Frequency Identification (abbr. RFID) and Near Field Communication (abbr.
NFC)—are the future of asset tracking, inventory management, and even interactive marketing. In very
simplified terms, think of RFID and NFC as the new and improved alternatives to barcoding AND QR
codes.

## [**Label Equipment**
## and Supplies][55]

MPI Labels is an industry leader when it comes to all things “labels” so it should come as no
surprise that we have an entire department dedicated to helping your business determine the right
labeling equipment for your needs. Whether you’re utilizing us for your label production or not, we
are here to help you determine what labeling systems and equipment your business should be
implementing.  Our labeling systems and equipment include label applicators, print and apply
systems, RFID labeling equipment, heat shrink sleeve applicators, heat tunnels, steam tunnels, steam
generators, and standard and custom made systems, stands, and accessories.

We can source the largest collection of equipment replacement parts and printer consumables- such as
ink, drums, ribbon, software, and more. Whatever labeling device, MPI Labels can supply you all the
supplies, parts, and support to continue printing uninterrupted.

exactly what we produce. So although, the official business name NPC remains unchanged, our current
website and branding echoes the very essence of our operations: National Custom Labels.

[creation of custom labels][20] designed to address the distinctive needs of our unique clientele.
We understand that you may encounter clients whose label requirements surpass the capabilities of
generic, stock labels. Possibly, such businesses might have been declined in the past due to the
complexity of their needs?

Today, National Custom Labels presents you with an unparalleled opportunity. Not only can you
generate additional revenue from these challenging orders, but you can also diversify your client
base and stimulate the growth of your business. Partnering with National could open up new horizons
for your venture and contribute to its sustained success.

We offer a wide range of custom labels and tags available in a variety of sizes and shapes. Custom
labels available in an endless combination of adhesives and face stocks. Our custom labels and tags
process on all major print technologies. Custom labels on a roll, sheet, or piece.  Thermal Transfer
Ribbons are available, as well! If you have a custom label need, we can fulfill it.

## Why Work With National Custom Labels?

****
**Scientific process with professional collaboration!**
We work with you to define your exact requirements then get to work using our process developed over
50 years to create the custom label you were looking for.

**Plain ID Products!**
If you desire we will stay completely invisible to your clients with absolutely brand free
communications and delivery of your custom label products.

**Clear Communications**
You’ll have a dedicated product manager and you can connect with our support team online or good old
fashion phone any time you wish to discuss your label project.

**Fast Shipping and Delivery**
Centrally located in Indiana, once your order is complete it will be shipped immediately. Want to
know the status of your order? Connect with us via chat or call us for the latest status.

* CUSTOM SIZES UP TO 18″ WIDE BY 24″ LONG

* THERMAL TRANSFER

* PADDING

# Custom Automation. Seamless Integration.

Navus delivers concept-to-completion automation services to some of the world’s foremost companies.
We analyze complex systems to find the ideal solution for your business.

[ Get Started ][23]
[ See Our Projects ][24]

## We Solve Your Toughest Problems.

For more than 25 years, Navus has set the standard in machine automation. From the initial system
analysis to our final implementation, our experts work closely with you to create a turnkey robotic
solution that increases safety, drives productivity, and maximizes your return on investment.

Navus designs advanced automated systems and precision metal components that readily integrate into
your existing operations. Whether you need a fully automated assembly line or a specialized robotic
welding arm, our engineers develop highly efficient systems that not only solve your current
challenges but also future-proof your business.

 

 

25-ton
Dual Trolley Gantry Crane Equipped for Heavy Industry

100%
Turnkey Solutions Completely Developed In-House

50%+
Production Time Reduction

23,000 sq. ft.
Fully Vertically Integrated Facility

### Welding

### Automation Consultation

We establish proof-of-concept through small-scale pilots and CAD technology.

][28]

## Our Facility

Our Knoxville, Tennessee facility is built to handle large-scale, multi-ton projects. From our
25-foot bay door to our 25-ton dual trolley gantry crane, we’re equipped to tackle your heaviest
jobs.
* * Advanced 3d CAD Modeling Software

 
* * Dedicated Fabrication and Assembly Bays

 
* * Production Environment Simulations

 
* Wide Loading Docks for Oversized Parts

[Industrial robot being assembled in a warehouse.]
[Welder working on metal at workshop.]

## Our Team

Navus is a vertically integrated company with full machining services and in-house capabilities for
assembly and programming.

Our world-class team of mechanical, electrical, and design engineers has helped Navus become a
globally recognized full-service automation integrator.

We’ve worked with top Fortune 500 companies in defense, consumer packaging, and more.

[ Request a Quote ][29]

## Industries We Work With
* Aerospace
* Automotive
* Defense
* Food and Beverage
* Logistics
* Manufacturing
* Medical Devices
* Pharmaceuticals
* Retail and Consumer Goods
* Transportation

From pick-and-place systems to complex multi-process welders, we design automation solutions
customized to your needs.

Play Video

## Our Process

## Step 1

## Strategize

Our experts will consult with your team to develop a strategic, data-driven automation plan, based
on a comprehensive analysis of your current production operations, pain points, and business goals.

## Step 2

## Build

We enter the design and engineering phase to develop a reliable, replicable, custom solution
tailored to your exact specifications and performance requirements.

## Step 3

## Implement

When everything’s ready, we handle installation and integration into your existing facility, as well
as comprehensive training for your team and ongoing support for peak performance.

[ Get Started ][30]

## Our Results

“The system that Navus designed took a process that **traditionally took 16 hours and accomplished
it in 4 hours**.”

[ See How ][31]

“Navus helped **reduce the welding time by nearly 70%** by utilizing two inverted robots, twin wire
welding, and moving the beams instead of the cell.”

[ See How ][32]

“Navus provided a custom cell utilizing six robots to weld and clean oddly-shaped parts weighing up
to 30 tons that **reduced the part manufacturing time by 53%**.”

[ See How ][33]
[Two people talking in an industrial workspace.]

## Consult with Our Experts

Schedule a no-obligation call to discuss your project with the Navus team. Let’s forge a better
future together.

[ Contact Us ][34]
[ [White Navus wordmark with circular emblem] ][35]

# ***Product Display***

[
[Automatic-weigh-price-labelling-machines1-(1)]
01

### Automatic weigh-price labelling machines

NCN fully automatic online weighing, printing, and labeling machine is designed for the food
processing and manufacturing industries. With a robust modular design, it ensures precise weighing,
intelligent printing, and efficient labeling. Its intuitive and user-friendly operation enhances
production line automation.
][130]
[
[labeller2-(1)]
01

### Labeller

The NCN-1550 Online Printing Labeling Machine integrates precise labeling, high-speed printing, and
intelligent traceability. Seamlessly connecting with production lines, it enables efficient batch
product identification and management. Featuring a modular stainless steel design and a
high-definition touchscreen, it supports visual editing for easy and efficient operation. Widely
used in the food, pharmaceutical, and logistics industries, it helps businesses upgrade to automated
production.
][131]
[
[Inspection-systems-(1)]
01

### Inspection Systems

The NCN series metal detectors integrate ultra-sensitive detection technology with intelligent
algorithms, ensuring precise identification of various metal contaminants and guaranteeing product
quality and safety. Equipped with a high-efficiency signal processing system, they are ideal for the
food, pharmaceutical, and chemical industries. Featuring a robust stainless steel structure and
modular design, they adapt to diverse production requirements, helping enterprises achieve more
efficient quality control.
][132]
[
[NCN Vertical Packaging System (1)]
01

### Food Packaging Systems

This system combines a high-precision 10-head multihead weigher with a versatile vertical
form-fill-seal (VFFS) machine, offering a fully automated packaging solution for food and non-food
granular products.
][133]
[
[software]
01

### Software solutions

NCN’s advanced software solutions are designed to enhance automation, efficiency, and accuracy in
industrial labeling and quality control processes. Our intelligent systems provide seamless
integration with production lines, real-time data analysis, and customizable label design. With
user-friendly interfaces and cloud-based connectivity, our software ensures precision, compliance,
and operational optimization for industries such as food, pharmaceuticals, and manufacturing.
Empower your business with smart, scalable, and future-ready software solutions.
][134]

01

### Labels

Our high-quality labeling products are designed to meet the diverse needs of modern industries. From
barcode labels to RFID tags, we provide innovative and durable solutions that ensure efficient
tracking, identification, and compliance. Whether for manufacturing, logistics, retail, or
healthcare, our labeling solutions enhance operational accuracy and productivity. Explore our wide
range of customizable labels to optimize your workflow.

## Integrated Warehouse Automation Solutions

[Numina Group]
1. Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR) and Voice Picking

Real-time Distribution Software (RDS) Order Release and Pick by Voice, combined with our Gen 3
advanced AMRs, support both large capacity batch cart picking and mixed case pick-to-pallet
applications. The RDS application module, Batchbot™, unites people and robots to enable faster
picking by reducing walk time by 50% and increasing operator pick rates by 50-100%. Numina's latest
generation 3,300 lbs. capacity AMRs can pick up to 30 orders per mission, boosting productivity to
**the industry's highest hourly AMR pick rates.**

[Learn about high performance AMR order picking][172]
2. Robotic GTP

Robotic GTP optimizes product storage, retrieval, and order picking. Voice and pick-to-light order
consolidation walls at the GTP workstations batch pick 32 orders at a time, increasing picks per
tote visit and achieving over 300 line picks per hour for higher productivity. Our conveyor-based
pack automation technologies combine pick and pack to carton processes with in-line scan-weight

headsets improves pick rates by 20-30% over RF terminal picking technology. Combining voice picking

time, pick time, and enhances pack validation for a leaner, faster, and highly accurate single-step
order picking process.

[Learn more about Voice Directed Batch Cart Picking][174]
4. High Performance Pick Module

Optimized multi-level storage and picking solutions provide high-capacity A, B, and C mover product
storage in the same module, with 225+ lines/hr. pick rates using RDS Voice Picking for case picking
and pick direct-to-shipping carton applications.

[Learn More about Pick Modules][175]
5. Pick to Light

RDS pick-to-light (PTL) displays include push-button confirmation for each action, directing the
fastest pick rates in dense storage, high-moving SKU pick zones. PTL is also well-suited for
sort-by-light and order consolidation put walls used in Goods to Person picking and warehouse order
picking when consolidating picks from multiple zones.

[Learn More about Pick to Light][176]
6. Auto Scan, Weigh, Vision Audit and Labeling

Automatically scan, label, apply and manifest (S.L.A.M). This technology scans, weighs, dims, and
captures images of cases and carton contents for order validation and improved customer service.
This data can also be combined with print and apply labeling to automate the application of retail
compliance, carrier shipping labels, and manifesting.

[Learn More about Scan Weigh Vision Audit & Labeling][177]
7. Print and Apply Labeling and Manifesting

Automatically manifest, print, and apply shipping labels without any manual touches. Automatically
print and apply shipping labels, parcel carrier and LTL order identifying labels, packing slips or a
full 8.5” x 11” packing sheet.

[Learn More about Pack and Ship Automation][178]
8. PFI Document Print and Insertion

Automatically insert packing slips, product specific instructions, marketing materials, or
compliance documentation at a rate of 12 cartons per hour.

[Learn More about PFI][179]
9. Pack Work Station

Rules-based solution for void insertion, packing sheet insertion, and automatic taping of shipping
cartons. It automates these tasks, cutting labor costs, boosting accuracy, and enhancing
productivity. With a single operator, it can process 6 cartons per minute.

[Learn More about Pakt][180]
10. Parcel Trailer Loading

Automatically divert shipping containers based on parcel carriers, LTL, and FTL designations.

## The best free DYMO alternative

Tired of DYMO Connect crashing? You're not alone.

DYMO Connect is the official software for DYMO LabelWriter printers — and it's universally disliked.
It's slow, crashes frequently, requires a bulky download, and only works with DYMO printers. Since
the LabelWriter 550 series, DYMO has even added DRM to their label rolls, forcing you to buy only
DYMO-branded labels at premium prices.

**OpenLabelMaker is a free, web-based DYMO alternative** that solves all of these problems. It runs
entirely in your browser — no download, no installation, no updates to manage. It works with all
DYMO label sizes (99010, 99012, 99014, 11354, and more), and it exports PDF files at the exact
dimensions your DYMO LabelWriter expects.

But unlike DYMO Connect, OpenLabelMaker also works with Brother, Zebra, Rollo, Avery, and literally
any other printer. Design once, print anywhere. If you've been searching for a DYMO alternative that
actually works, give OpenLabelMaker a try.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is OpenLabelMaker free?

The core editor is completely free — design, print, barcodes, QR codes, custom sizes, 150+ fonts. No
account needed, no watermarks, no ads. Batch data import is free up to 5 times per month. Need more?
Pro is just $5/mo for unlimited imports — with a 7-day free trial. [See pricing →][11]

### Does it work with my DYMO printer?

Yes! OpenLabelMaker includes all popular DYMO label sizes (99010, 99012, 99014, 11354, 99015, 99017,
99019, 11356). Select your DYMO label size from the size picker, design your label, and export as
PDF at the exact dimensions your DYMO LabelWriter expects.

### What printers does OpenLabelMaker work with?

Any printer. We have built-in presets for DYMO LabelWriter, Brother QL series, Zebra thermal
printers, and Rollo printers. For inkjet and laser printers, we support all common Avery sheet label
sizes. You can also enter custom dimensions for any label size you need.

### Can I create barcodes and QR codes?

Yes! OpenLabelMaker supports Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 39, ITF-14, and Pharmacode barcodes, plus
QR codes. All generated directly in your browser — no external API needed. You can edit barcode and
QR code values anytime from the properties panel.

### Is my data private?

Completely. OpenLabelMaker runs 100% in your browser. Your label designs, images, and data never
leave your computer. We don't have servers processing your data, we don't track your designs, and we
don't require an account. Your privacy is absolute.

### How is this different from DYMO Connect?

DYMO Connect requires a download, only works with DYMO printers, is known for crashes and bugs, and
forces you into DYMO's ecosystem. OpenLabelMaker is web-based (no download), works with ANY printer,
runs reliably in your browser, and is completely free with no lock-in.

### Can I use Avery label sheets?

Yes. We support popular Avery label sizes including L7160/5160 (21 per sheet), L7161/5161 (18 per
sheet), L7163/5163 (14 per sheet), L7165/5165 (8 per sheet), and more. Select the Avery size from
the label picker and design your individual label.

### What export formats are supported?

PDF (at exact label dimensions, 300 DPI quality — best for printing), PNG (3× resolution for
high-quality images), and direct print (opens print dialog with correct page size). You can also
save your design as a .olm.json file to edit later.

## The best free DYMO alternative

Tired of DYMO Connect crashing? You're not alone.

DYMO Connect is the official software for DYMO LabelWriter printers — and it's universally disliked.
It's slow, crashes frequently, requires a bulky download, and only works with DYMO printers. Since
the LabelWriter 550 series, DYMO has even added DRM to their label rolls, forcing you to buy only
DYMO-branded labels at premium prices.

**OpenLabelMaker is a free, web-based DYMO alternative** that solves all of these problems. It runs
entirely in your browser — no download, no installation, no updates to manage. It works with all
DYMO label sizes (99010, 99012, 99014, 11354, and more), and it exports PDF files at the exact
dimensions your DYMO LabelWriter expects.

But unlike DYMO Connect, OpenLabelMaker also works with Brother, Zebra, Rollo, Avery, and literally
any other printer. Design once, print anywhere. If you've been searching for a DYMO alternative that
actually works, give OpenLabelMaker a try.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is OpenLabelMaker free?

The core editor is completely free — design, print, barcodes, QR codes, custom sizes, 150+ fonts. No
account needed, no watermarks, no ads. Batch data import is free up to 5 times per month. Need more?
Pro is just $5/mo for unlimited imports — with a 7-day free trial. [See pricing →][11]

### Does it work with my DYMO printer?

Yes! OpenLabelMaker includes all popular DYMO label sizes (99010, 99012, 99014, 11354, 99015, 99017,
99019, 11356). Select your DYMO label size from the size picker, design your label, and export as
PDF at the exact dimensions your DYMO LabelWriter expects.

### What printers does OpenLabelMaker work with?

Any printer. We have built-in presets for DYMO LabelWriter, Brother QL series, Zebra thermal
printers, and Rollo printers. For inkjet and laser printers, we support all common Avery sheet label
sizes. You can also enter custom dimensions for any label size you need.

### Can I create barcodes and QR codes?

Yes! OpenLabelMaker supports Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 39, ITF-14, and Pharmacode barcodes, plus
QR codes. All generated directly in your browser — no external API needed. You can edit barcode and
QR code values anytime from the properties panel.

### Is my data private?

Completely. OpenLabelMaker runs 100% in your browser. Your label designs, images, and data never
leave your computer. We don't have servers processing your data, we don't track your designs, and we
don't require an account. Your privacy is absolute.

### How is this different from DYMO Connect?

DYMO Connect requires a download, only works with DYMO printers, is known for crashes and bugs, and
forces you into DYMO's ecosystem. OpenLabelMaker is web-based (no download), works with ANY printer,
runs reliably in your browser, and is completely free with no lock-in.

### Can I use Avery label sheets?

Yes. We support popular Avery label sizes including L7160/5160 (21 per sheet), L7161/5161 (18 per
sheet), L7163/5163 (14 per sheet), L7165/5165 (8 per sheet), and more. Select the Avery size from
the label picker and design your individual label.

### What export formats are supported?

PDF (at exact label dimensions, 300 DPI quality — best for printing), PNG (3× resolution for
high-quality images), and direct print (opens print dialog with correct page size). You can also
save your design as a .olm.json file to edit later.

### Do I need to create an account?

No. OpenLabelMaker works without any account, sign-up, or login. Open the editor, design your label,
export or print. That's it. Your designs are saved locally in your browser — we never see them.

label. Perfect for adding your company logo, product photos, or icons. Images stay on your device —

sostenible, por sus capacidad de generar acciones de manera proactiva, buscando inquietudes y
preocupaciones de los grupos de interés para crear soluciones de manera voluntaria y colectiva.

Por la posibilidad de acción y de influencia, creemos que es importante poner a su disposición como
Pegaprint contribuye socialmente, y con la mejora continua de la calidad para servir a nuestros
clientes y aportar a la sociedad y la economía.

What is Print-File.com and how does it work?

Print-File.com is a free online document printing tool that allows you to upload and print various
file types directly from your web browser without installing any software. Simply drag and drop or
select your file (PDF, Word document, image, or text file), preview it in your browser, and click
the print button to send it to your connected printer.

The entire process happens in your browser using client-side JavaScript, which means your files are
processed locally on your device for maximum privacy and security. No files are uploaded to external
servers.

What file formats are supported?

Print-File.com supports a wide range of common document and image formats:
* **PDF files** (.pdf) - Full support for standard PDF documents
* **Word documents** (.docx, .doc) - Microsoft Word files
* **Images** (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif) - Common image formats
* **Text files** (.txt) - Plain text documents

All formats are rendered accurately in the preview before printing, so you can verify the output
looks correct.

Is there a file size limit?

Yes, Print-File.com supports files up to **50MB in size**. This limit is in place to ensure optimal
performance and quick processing times in your browser.

Most standard documents are well under this limit. For reference, a typical PDF document is 1-5MB, a
Word document is 500KB-2MB, and images are usually 500KB-5MB. If you need to print a larger file,
consider splitting it into smaller parts or compressing it first.

Is my data safe and private?

**Absolutely.** Your privacy is our top priority. Print-File.com processes all files entirely in
your browser using JavaScript. This means:
* Your files **never leave your device**
* No files are uploaded to any server
* No data is stored or tracked
* Everything happens locally on your computer

Once you close the browser tab or refresh the page, the file is immediately cleared from memory. We
cannot access your files because they never reach our servers.

Do I need to install any software?

No installation required! Print-File.com is a completely web-based tool that runs directly in your
browser. There's no need to download, install, or update any software.

Simply visit the website, upload your file, and print. This works seamlessly on both macOS and
Windows without any platform-specific installations.

This makes it perfect for:
* Public computers or shared workstations
* Devices where you can't install software
* Quick one-time printing needs
* Mac users who don't want to install Adobe Reader or other PDF software
* Windows users looking for a lightweight alternative to heavy document readers
* Users who prefer not to clutter their system with additional programs

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes! Print-File.com is fully responsive and works on smartphones and tablets. You can upload files
from your mobile device and print to compatible wireless printers or save as PDF on mobile.

The interface automatically adapts to smaller screens, making it easy to preview and print documents
on the go. This is particularly useful when you need to print something from your phone or tablet to
a nearby printer.

Is Print-File.com really free?

Yes, Print-File.com is completely free to use with no hidden fees, subscriptions, or premium tiers.

The service is supported by non-intrusive ads, which help us keep the tool free and accessible for
everyone. You can print as many documents as you need without any restrictions or watermarks.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is Print-File.com and how does it work?

Print-File.com is a free online document printing tool that allows you to upload and print various
file types directly from your web browser without installing any software. Simply drag and drop or
select your file (PDF, Word document, image, or text file), preview it in your browser, and click
the print button to send it to your connected printer.

The entire process happens in your browser using client-side JavaScript, which means your files are
processed locally on your device for maximum privacy and security. No files are uploaded to external
servers.

What file formats are supported?

Print-File.com supports a wide range of common document and image formats:
* **PDF files** (.pdf) - Full support for standard PDF documents
* **Word documents** (.docx, .doc) - Microsoft Word files
* **Images** (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif) - Common image formats
* **Text files** (.txt) - Plain text documents

All formats are rendered accurately in the preview before printing, so you can verify the output
looks correct.

Is there a file size limit?

Yes, Print-File.com supports files up to **50MB in size**. This limit is in place to ensure optimal
performance and quick processing times in your browser.

Most standard documents are well under this limit. For reference, a typical PDF document is 1-5MB, a
Word document is 500KB-2MB, and images are usually 500KB-5MB. If you need to print a larger file,
consider splitting it into smaller parts or compressing it first.

Is my data safe and private?

**Absolutely.** Your privacy is our top priority. Print-File.com processes all files entirely in
your browser using JavaScript. This means:
* Your files **never leave your device**
* No files are uploaded to any server
* No data is stored or tracked
* Everything happens locally on your computer

Once you close the browser tab or refresh the page, the file is immediately cleared from memory. We
cannot access your files because they never reach our servers.

Do I need to install any software?

No installation required! Print-File.com is a completely web-based tool that runs directly in your
browser. There's no need to download, install, or update any software.

Simply visit the website, upload your file, and print. This works seamlessly on both macOS and
Windows without any platform-specific installations.

This makes it perfect for:
* Public computers or shared workstations
* Devices where you can't install software
* Quick one-time printing needs
* Mac users who don't want to install Adobe Reader or other PDF software
* Windows users looking for a lightweight alternative to heavy document readers
* Users who prefer not to clutter their system with additional programs

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes! Print-File.com is fully responsive and works on smartphones and tablets. You can upload files
from your mobile device and print to compatible wireless printers or save as PDF on mobile.

The interface automatically adapts to smaller screens, making it easy to preview and print documents
on the go. This is particularly useful when you need to print something from your phone or tablet to
a nearby printer.

Is Print-File.com really free?

Yes, Print-File.com is completely free to use with no hidden fees, subscriptions, or premium tiers.

The service is supported by non-intrusive ads, which help us keep the tool free and accessible for

Why isn't my file loading or previewing?

If your file isn't loading, here are some common solutions:
* **Check the file format** - Make sure it's one of the supported types (PDF, DOCX, PNG, JPG, TXT)
* **Verify file size** - Files must be under 50MB
* **Check for file corruption** - Try opening the file in another program to ensure it's not
  corrupted
* **Refresh the page** - Sometimes a simple refresh resolves temporary issues
* **Try a different browser** - If problems persist, test with another browser
* **Clear browser cache** - Cached data can sometimes interfere

* **Scaling** - Fit to page or custom scale

Print-File.com offers several advantages over traditional PDF reader software:

* **No updates** - Always access the latest version without manual updates
* **Cross-platform** - Works on Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS, and Android
* **No storage space** - Doesn't consume disk space on your device
* **Quick access** - Perfect for one-time or occasional printing needs
* **Privacy-focused** - Files processed locally, never uploaded

## Why Print Online

[
][121]

### The True Cost Of Printing

Printing at home can cost between 50c and several dollars per page depending on ink and toner usage.
Comparatively, our printing prices start from just 10 cents per page!

More than just monetary costs, there is also an environmental cost when you print at home. Millions
of cartridges and printer units are thrown away every year.

We help to break that cycle by offering commercial printing rates and fast delivery.

[Learn more][122]
[
][123]

### Our Machines

We use the latest print production technology to deliver you the highest quality printing at the
lowest price.

Capable of printing millions of prints a month, we definitely have capacity for your order!

Able to print on paper stock from 80gsm to 300gsm, our machines also offer finishing services like
folding, binding, stapling and punching for your documents.

[Learn more][124]
[
][125]

### Environmentally Responsible

At Print Online, we take every effort to operate sustainably. And our paper is sourced from
sustainably managed forests, recycled and controlled sources.

Just one of our Toner Cartridges can print upto 45,000 pages compared to one average Ink Cartridge
at 150 pages. This saves over 300 Ink Cartridges from landfill.

[Learn more][126]
[
][127]

### Get your project in on time

Order before 2pm, and receive your print overnight so you can make your project deadline.

[Start Printing][128]
[
][129]

### Ensure confidentiality

Print Online carries out each print job with 100% confidentiality and professionalism. We don't
share any user data with any insecure platforms.

[Start Printing][130]
[
][131]

### Easy, affordable printing

Receive your print in 3 easy steps, for a fraction of the cost compared to other printers and your
printer at home.

[Start Printing][132]

# Cheap Online Printing Service Australia

We make a real difference for hundreds of Australian businesses and households every month. Our low
print price per page is unbeatable in Australia and is especially important when you want to print
bigger documents like specifications, legal papers, educational materials, [posters][133],
[booklets][134], [building plans][135] and can wait one day to get your printing delivered on the
next working day. Our online printing service is a great alternative to traditional print shops and
office/home printers. No more hassle and lots of print cost savings without mentioning time wastage
and cartridge costs. We have a growing number of individuals, [schools][136] and [businesses][137]
who are our repeat customers and are very satisfied with our unique online printing service. We
provide cheap document printing services and send many parcels across Australia each day.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get quick answers about custom label printing, MOQ, shipping, and support

Q1: Are you a manufacturer or trading company? +
A: Xinsen Packaging is a **direct manufacturer** with our own 2000㎡ factory in Qingdao, China since
2008. We are NOT a trading company. You are welcome to visit our facility.
Q2: What is your MOQ for custom labels? +
A: Our MOQ is **1,000 pcs per design** for standard labels. For sample orders, we offer small
quantity (500 pcs) for new customers. No MOQ for sample requests.
Q3: What printing technologies do you offer? +
A: We offer **flexographic, offset, digital, and screen printing**. Special processes include hot
stamping, embossing, debossing, varnish, and custom die-cutting.
Q4: What is the typical lead time? +
A: Standard lead time: **7-15 working days** after artwork approval. Express service (3-5 days)
available for urgent orders.
Q5: Do you provide artwork and design support? +
A: Yes. Our team provides **free artwork checking and optimization**. We accept AI, PDF, CDR, and
EPS formats. Design services available for new customers.
Q6: Do you ship internationally? Which countries do you export to? +
A: Yes. We export to **24+ countries** including USA, Canada, UK, Germany, France, Australia, Japan,
South Korea, and Southeast Asia. We ship by air (3-7 days) or sea (20-35 days).

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get quick answers about custom label printing, MOQ, shipping, and support

Q1: Are you a manufacturer or trading company? +
A: Xinsen Packaging is a **direct manufacturer** with our own 2000㎡ factory in Qingdao, China since
2008. We are NOT a trading company. You are welcome to visit our facility.
Q2: What is your MOQ for custom labels? +
A: Our MOQ is **1,000 pcs per design** for standard labels. For sample orders, we offer small
quantity (500 pcs) for new customers. No MOQ for sample requests.
Q3: What printing technologies do you offer? +
A: We offer **flexographic, offset, digital, and screen printing**. Special processes include hot
stamping, embossing, debossing, varnish, and custom die-cutting.
Q4: What is the typical lead time? +
A: Standard lead time: **7-15 working days** after artwork approval. Express service (3-5 days)
available for urgent orders.
Q5: Do you provide artwork and design support? +
A: Yes. Our team provides **free artwork checking and optimization**. We accept AI, PDF, CDR, and
EPS formats. Design services available for new customers.
Q6: Do you ship internationally? Which countries do you export to? +
A: Yes. We export to **24+ countries** including USA, Canada, UK, Germany, France, Australia, Japan,
South Korea, and Southeast Asia. We ship by air (3-7 days) or sea (20-35 days).

## **About Our Company**

Thermal Star ® Paper Roll is a registered trademark of Shenzhen Sailing Paper Products Co., Ltd., a
leading manufacturer and supplier of paper rolls in China. Sailing Group includes subsidiaries like
Evergreen and Petra under its umbrella. For over 19 years, we have been industry leaders in paper
roll manufacturing, with countless satisfied customers.

We produce a wide range of thermal paper and thermal label products for various applications,
including airline tickets, lottery paper, ECG paper, ATM paper, and A4 labels. Our products are used
in diverse markets such as retail supermarkets, hotels, logistics, gaming, and many others.
Currently, our company boasts over 100 employees, 40 advanced slitting machines, 10 die-cutting
machines, and 5 printing presses. These resources enable us to provide high-quality products to our
customers quickly and efficiently.

An exciting and important aspect of this industry is the continuous daily use of thermal paper in
millions of locations—this can bring you significant and sustained profits. Our unique advantage is
that, by purchasing directly from the thermal paper roll manufacturer, our prices are at least 5% to
10% lower than those of other thermal paper suppliers!

## **About Our Company**

Thermal Star ® Paper Roll is a registered trademark of Shenzhen Sailing Paper Products Co., Ltd., a
leading manufacturer and supplier of paper rolls in China. Sailing Group includes subsidiaries like
Evergreen and Petra under its umbrella. For over 19 years, we have been industry leaders in paper
roll manufacturing, with countless satisfied customers.

We produce a wide range of thermal paper and thermal label products for various applications,
including airline tickets, lottery paper, ECG paper, ATM paper, and A4 labels. Our products are used
in diverse markets such as retail supermarkets, hotels, logistics, gaming, and many others.
Currently, our company boasts over 100 employees, 40 advanced slitting machines, 10 die-cutting
machines, and 5 printing presses. These resources enable us to provide high-quality products to our
customers quickly and efficiently.

An exciting and important aspect of this industry is the continuous daily use of thermal paper in
millions of locations—this can bring you significant and sustained profits. Our unique advantage is
that, by purchasing directly from the thermal paper roll manufacturer, our prices are at least 5% to

# Your way.

From labeling to tracking – BarTender helps you adapt, connect, and scale everything that moves
through the supply chain. 

[What's New in BarTender 12][73]

Trusted by Top Global Companies

repetitive tasks and achieve operational efficiency.

# Staples drives your business with an extensive product assortment wherever you need it.

At Staples, we’ve been providing our customers with an extensive assortment of essential office
supplies for over 35 years. From writing supplies and paper to shredders and school supplies,
Staples is the [office supply][123] expert. We are a top provider of office chairs, desks, tables &
office furniture. We also offer the latest technology—from laptops, computers & accessories, to
printers, ink & toner, and more. We have all the tools you need to stay productive and connected,
plus a wide assortment of unexpected [new & trending products][124] like luggage, smart home
technology, gaming consoles & accessories, décor, and gift cards.


[Staples has everything you could ever need for school.]

### Back to School Made Easy at Staples

For students and parents, Staples is a one-stop shop for all [school supplies][125]. Parents and
students can find everything they need to succeed, from notebooks and art materials to backpacks and
lunch boxes. Teachers will appreciate our extensive selection of classroom essentials, including
educational materials, classroom decor, organizational tools, and more. [Find your school supply
list][126] & shop for everything you need, all in one place!


[Wireless headphones are essential while traveling.]

### Staples Travel Hub

Whether your next trip is for business or pleasure, [Staples Travel Hub][127] is your new
destination for all things travel. Find luggage and travel accessories, and tech gadgets to make
your trip run smoothly. Visit us in-store to take advantage of our [TSA PreCheck][128] and passport
services.


[Prioritizing wellness throughout your day.]

### Health & Wellness

Staples range of [health & wellness products][129] can enhance your workspace and overall
well-being. Shop ergonomic furniture & tech options, as well as smart watches, candles, essential
oils & more. Our curved whiteboard has an ergonomically crafted shape to prevent strain. And a new
selection of [guided journals][130] are available, with topics including anxiety & productivity.


[Take advantage of Staples EasyRewards and AutoRestock and check another thing off your list for
good.]

### Perks of Shopping Staples

We pride ourselves on making shopping a breeze. With [Staples Easy Rewards][131], you can earn
rewards on every purchase, plus extra rewards on your chosen bonus categories. Our
[AutoRestock][132] feature ensures you never run out of essential supplies, with easy-to-manage
subscriptions. Whether you prefer to shop in-store or online, we offer flexible options for
shipping, same-day delivery, or in-store pickup.



At Staples, we are here to help you navigate your business, office, and school needs with ease.
Explore our website and discover all that Staples has to offer. We're confident you will find
exactly what you're looking for and more.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

### Thermal Solutions

Our core business is the production of thermal labels, both direct thermal and thermal transfer.

[EXPLORE THERMAL SOLUTIONS][243]

[RFID Icon]

### RFID **Labels** 

RFID labels are an excellent solution for companies looking to increase speed and accuracy of data
collection.

[EXPLORE OUR RFID LABEL CAPABILITIES][244]

[digital-labels]

### Digital **Labels**

With DLSdigital™ you can produce shorter run labels in virtually any size and any shape quickly.

[EXPLORE OUR DIGITAL LABEL OPTIONS][245]

[warehouse-labels]

### Warehouse **Labels**

Labels that streamline warehouse operations. In addition to labels, offer install services.

[GET STARTED WITH WAREHOUSE LABELING][246]

#  Nationwide **Trade-ONLY Label
# Manufacturer**

DLS has been a preferred B2B label supplier since 1985. Over the years, we’ve grown to be one of the
largest trade-only label manufacturers in the country. We provide high-quality, custom-printed
pressure sensitive labels to distributors throughout the U.S. And all of our products, from blank
labels to full color high-definition labels, are produced utilizing the latest in flexographic and
digital printing technologies.

 

DLS’s dedicated team is passionate about labels. Our motto is, “We only succeed when you do.” And
we’re always ready to share our expertise with our distributors to help you grow your business.
Whether your customer needs 100 or a 100,000,000 labels, DLS helps with any size order. We are a
nationwide label converter. Our headquarters is centrally located in Itasca, Illinois, and DLS has
label production and warehouse facilities located in five states across the U.S. Our nationwide
presence means fast, affordable delivery to your customers. In 2019, DLS became a member of the TSC
Auto ID Technology family, a global leader in the AIDC barcode printer industry. DLS is the
manufacturer of OEM media for both TSC and Printronix thermal Auto ID printers.

 

##  INDUSTRY-LEADING **LABEL SUPPLIER**

COMPLETE LABEL SOLUTION

 


#### Grow Your Business

No other label partner will offer you the quality and selection of label marketing materials, as
well as the in-depth training you need to close more label business.


#### 5 Locations

We operate 5 locations (Chicago, Atlanta, Dallas, Reno, and Riverside, CA). This allows us to ship
all of our products quickly and affordably.


#### Distributor Only

We don't compete with you on bids. We sell ONLY through OEMs and value-added resellers like you.


#### Your Silent Partner

Diversified is your silent partner, discreetly drop-shipping your orders to customers.


#### Manufacturing Strength

We have more than 35 years experience. Our experts provide the label manufacturing muscle you need
to sell high-quality labels.


#### Cost Efficiency

We keep our costs low through efficient manufacturing, lean overhead and no competing sales force.

##  BECOME A **DLS DISTRIBUTOR**

TAKE YOUR LABEL SALES TO NEW HEIGHTS

When partnering with DLS, you get more than just a trade only label supplier. We are your business
partner, and we help you market to your customers. DLS makes it easy for you.
When you work with DLS as your label supplier you get:
* Training to help you find the best strategy for selling labels.
* Custom branded marketing materials
* Unmatched customer service and technical support
* Quotes in three hours or less.
* Nationwide production and shipping from five locations across the U.S.

 

Overall, we offer the best label production and distribution services in the industry.

 

[BECOME A DISTRIBUTOR][247]

## **THERMAL**
## SOLUTIONS

Your choice for a complete thermal label solution, from the experts in thermal printing.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT THERMAL LABEL SOLUTIONS][249]


 

##  OUR COMMITMENT TO ** SUSTAINABILITY **

 

We’ve instituted eco-friendly label manufacturing practices aimed at recycling, reducing waste and
decreasing the need for fossil fuels. We are especially proud of our fuel pellet program. By turning
label production waste into fuel pellets, we keep over 2 million pounds of waste per year out of
landfills. Additionally, as a coal alternative, these fuel pellets generate electricity while
reducing CO2 emissions by 40%. It is our hope that with sustainability efforts like this, we can
continue to not only do the right thing, but also help you reach buyers who take corporate
responsibility seriously.

#  Nationwide **Trade-ONLY Label
# Manufacturer**

DLS has been a preferred B2B label supplier since 1985. Over the years, we’ve grown to be one of the
largest trade-only label manufacturers in the country. We provide high-quality, custom-printed
pressure sensitive labels to distributors throughout the U.S. And all of our products, from blank
labels to full color high-definition labels, are produced utilizing the latest in flexographic and
digital printing technologies.

 

DLS’s dedicated team is passionate about labels. Our motto is, “We only succeed when you do.” And
we’re always ready to share our expertise with our distributors to help you grow your business.
Whether your customer needs 100 or a 100,000,000 labels, DLS helps with any size order. We are a
nationwide label converter. Our headquarters is centrally located in Itasca, Illinois, and DLS has
label production and warehouse facilities located in five states across the U.S. Our nationwide
presence means fast, affordable delivery to your customers. In 2019, DLS became a member of the TSC
Auto ID Technology family, a global leader in the AIDC barcode printer industry. DLS is the
manufacturer of OEM media for both TSC and Printronix thermal Auto ID printers.

 

##  INDUSTRY-LEADING **LABEL SUPPLIER**

COMPLETE LABEL SOLUTION

 


#### Grow Your Business

No other label partner will offer you the quality and selection of label marketing materials, as
well as the in-depth training you need to close more label business.


#### 5 Locations

We operate 5 locations (Chicago, Atlanta, Dallas, Reno, and Riverside, CA). This allows us to ship
all of our products quickly and affordably.


#### Distributor Only

We don't compete with you on bids. We sell ONLY through OEMs and value-added resellers like you.


#### Your Silent Partner

Diversified is your silent partner, discreetly drop-shipping your orders to customers.


#### Manufacturing Strength

We have more than 35 years experience. Our experts provide the label manufacturing muscle you need
to sell high-quality labels.


#### Cost Efficiency

We keep our costs low through efficient manufacturing, lean overhead and no competing sales force.

##  BECOME A **DLS DISTRIBUTOR**

TAKE YOUR LABEL SALES TO NEW HEIGHTS

When partnering with DLS, you get more than just a trade only label supplier. We are your business
partner, and we help you market to your customers. DLS makes it easy for you.
When you work with DLS as your label supplier you get:
* Training to help you find the best strategy for selling labels.
* Custom branded marketing materials
* Unmatched customer service and technical support
* Quotes in three hours or less.
* Nationwide production and shipping from five locations across the U.S.

 

Overall, we offer the best label production and distribution services in the industry.

##  OUR COMMITMENT TO ** SUSTAINABILITY **

 

We’ve instituted eco-friendly label manufacturing practices aimed at recycling, reducing waste and
decreasing the need for fossil fuels. We are especially proud of our fuel pellet program. By turning
label production waste into fuel pellets, we keep over 2 million pounds of waste per year out of
landfills. Additionally, as a coal alternative, these fuel pellets generate electricity while
reducing CO2 emissions by 40%. It is our hope that with sustainability efforts like this, we can
continue to not only do the right thing, but also help you reach buyers who take corporate
responsibility seriously.

## Got Questions about Music Distribution? 

### Which streaming platforms do you distribute to?

+

Our digital music distribution service distributes to all the major streaming services: Spotify,
Apple Music, TikTok, YouTube, Deezer, Tidal and 200+ other streaming platforms and stores globally.

### What makes this platform different from other music distribution platforms?

+

We offer free accounts to verified artists who what proven industry traction. This is a strict
application process though our A&R team who review every single applicant.

Why do we do this? 
- We are actively combating streaming fraud in the the music industry
- To ensure that no bad actors get access to our system and take advantage of the tools we offer
- To promote good practices within the music industry
- We want to be proud of all of the music that we distribute and work on at Unchained Music.  

### How do I transfer my catalog from another music distributor?

+

Transferring your catalog from another music distribution service is simple. Before you start,
you’ll need a few key pieces of information, including:
‍

• The UPC and ISRC (these help DSPs identify your existing release);
• Release title and track title(s);Artist(s) name(s);
• The Original Release date and;
• The exact same audio and cover art files from the previous release.

This is the same process for almost every digital music distribution company.

### Are there any fees and do I keep all my royalties?

+

For immediate access to the platform there is a base subscription fee. Artists and labels keep all
there royalties.

For a highly select group of artists we offer free use of our platform, but this at the discretion
of the A&R team. Artists and labels under this core plan also keep 100% of their royalties.

Our unchained partners are all subject to custom deals for our artist and label services.

### Do you offer playlisting or marketing support?

+

Yes - we offer full artists and label services to a select artists. You can find out more [here][68]

# USPS.com Home Page

## Online Shipping Made Easy

Ship from home in 3 easy steps. Use our online Click-N-Ship^{®} service to pay for postage, print
your own shipping labels, and schedule a free package pickup.

[**Ship Now**][160][**Learn More**][161]

**Postmarks:** If you want to ensure that your mail receives a postmark on the day you mail it, ask

## Featured USPS^{®} Products & Services

[Person looking at a clipboard with shelves of packages in the background]

### USPS Ground Advantage^{®}

USPS Ground Advantage is a great option for shippers of all sizes with delivery in 2-5* days and
USPS Tracking^{®} included in the price.

[Learn More about USPS Ground Advantage.][184]

*For mailable items up to 70 lbs. Expected delivery in 2-5 days. Packages going to certain places
(including Alaska, Hawaii, and offshore destinations) or containing hazardous materials or live
animals may receive slower service.

[Informed Delivery Daily Digest email on a smartphone.]

### Informed Delivery^{®} Emails

On the go? Stay on top of your mail and package deliveries with free Daily Digest emails that show
you what's coming to your mailbox soon.

[Sign Up for Free for Informed Delivery Emails.][185]

[Small Business owner preparing to ship Priority Mail packages.]

### Small Business Solutions

Get back to business with direct mail. Send announcements and promotions to your target customers
along selected postal routes.

[Learn More about Small Business Solutions][186]

[A PO Box with a key in the lock.]

### PO Box^{™} Online Services

Get a PO Box to keep all your mail secure at a Post Office^{™} facility. Reserve and then manage
your PO Box easily online with a free USPS.com account.

[Go Now for PO Box Online Services][187]

document that gave voice to America's founding ideals.

[Buy Declaration of Independence Forever® Stamps Now][188]

control and faster development of custom labels. [More about United Label][101]

### Labels for businesses and industry

We print die cut and laminate labels on paper, films, foils, Mylar and cardstock including hot

Free Quote Today**][106]

#### Pet Product Labels

[[custom pressure sensitive labels]][107]

The pet industry encompasses United Label’s largest client base. United Label takes pride in our
service to the  pet industry and in providing labels for pet products. We have an understanding of
the requirements for pet product labels as well as how to design pet product labels that look good
on the shelf. [More on Pet Industry Labels][108]

#### Custom Die Shapes for Labels

United Label has  a vast number of dies for a wide variety of label shapes. A die is a laser
engraved hardened steel tool  that allows us to cut your label into the final desired shape. Our
extensive die library of label shapes allows you to choose any stock die which best suits your needs
without incurring expensive tooling charges. [More On Custom Label Die Shapes][109]

#### Nutraceutical Labels

[[nutrition labels]][110]

United Label are experts in nutrition labels, printing a broad variety of nutraceutical labels for
dietary supplements, vitamins and herbal products.

Our experience serving the nutraceutical industry affords us an understanding of the specific needs
and challenges of nutrition labels. [More on Nutraceutical Labels][111]

#### United Label Corporation

United Label Corporation of Newark, New Jersey, manufacturers custom printed pressure sensitive
labels for commercial use, has offered labeling services to a large spectrum of New York, New Jersey
and US businesses for over forty years.
United Label Corporation prints [die cut][112] and laminate in line on [paper][113], [films][114],
[foils][115], [Mylar][116] and cardstock. We offer printing in up to four colors, including four
color process (full color) printing.[label printing press]
